title: Discovery of lanthanide metal oxide catalyst for transesterification reaction by fluorescence-based high-throughput screening method and application to biodiesel production
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8102-8110
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08489F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jeong Yup Ryoo, Mingyeong Jang, Taeho Lim, Min Su Han
Transition and lanthanide metal oxide catalysts for transesterification were rapidly evaluated using fluorescence-based HTS method, achieving transesterification for organic substrates and soybean oil with minimal amounts of selected catalyst.
